text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute has steadfastly produced
great
results throughout her first three
years in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And not only that, she continues to do
so over
the next three years as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the next three years after that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did you bathe in the fountain of youth
or
something, Acute?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's the only thing that makes any
sense! First
of all, you were racing for
years before I even
debuted...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And even now that I'm a senior runner,
you're still
running with the best of
them!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's true. I think the reason
I'm still so
spry...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is because I eat these every day. Here,
go ahead
and try some.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Pickled veggies... I know they're
supposed to promote longevity, but that
still doesn't explain
what you've been
able to do.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Don't overthink it, Rickey. We just need
to
accept that Acute is a legend.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You know, like an idol who's always
there shining
on stage year after year.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Hmmm, but racing is a
sport, so I
don't think it can be that
easy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In just a few years,
the dirt lineup in the
Twinkle
Series has completely changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is now an ace in her
prime, bold and confident. And Copano
Rickey has transformed from a promising
youngster into a
full-fledged champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many new Umamusume have made their
racing
debuts, while others have
stepped away from the
track. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only Wonder Acute is running exactly as
she was
before, as if the sands of time
can't touch her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't know if you remember, but
people
have been calling me a granny
from the second I
debuted.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So even as I've actually gotten on in
years,
nothing has really changed. Nope,
not a thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess I can see what she's getting at...
but
personally, I'm curious to see if
that's really true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To find out, I look into what the dirt
Umamusume
she's raced across the years
have had to say
about her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Can you tell me what you
think about
Wonder Acute?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute? Ahaha! ☆ She's like an adorable
little
sister...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well,
if my little sis was also a granny, I
guess. Oh, and she always runs at her
best, no matter
the time or place. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That includes when the cameras aren't
rolling. ♪
I've never seen her ease up.
Not once.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer F
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Falco used to dote on her quite a
bit. She
reminded me of a sweet old
lady, even though
she was just a rookie.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer F
text_block_list.text:
Still, she was not to be underestimated
during a
race. She always ran with all her
might...

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer E
text_block_list.text:
Me and Falco used to talk 'bout her all
the time. I
mean, she was one helluva
rookie.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer E
text_block_list.text: It was like she had her sights set higher, y'know? She was so... unshakeable. Nothing got under her skin.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer T
text_block_list.text:
We're about the same age, actually.
Hard to
believe, right? I mean, her
whole personality just
screams granny...

text_block_list.name: Dirt Racer T
text_block_list.text:
But y'know, she really was the backbone
of our
generation. Watching her work so
hard made us
wanna do the same.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She did so much for me! Rickey and I
would really
miss running with her if she
stopped!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. There's no real concept of
monsters or
demons in feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But seeing that unwavering consistency
of hers
sometimes makes me think she's
the avatar of
some spiritual force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every generation had the same
impression of her, specifically that she
reminded them of a granny.
But not only
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them says she always gave
it her all, no matter the time or place.
Even after so many
years, that hasn't
changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is it really so strange that I've been
able
to keep
competing all this time?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh... you know what? I bet it's because none of them know about that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know. That thing you do for me
before every
race. The shoulder
massage.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It always fills me with emotion, no matter
how
many times you do it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been able to stay so spry.
And why
I never changed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You've given me so much... far more than
I could
ever count.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I reflect on the numerous feelings I put
into our pre-race routine. When she first
debuted, it was
merely a way to get her
psyched up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the meaning changed over the years. 
Sometimes it was more like a strong
massage, other times it was a prayer that
she'd return
unscathed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was always the same massage, but the
feelings behind it differed. I put in
whatever I believed
Wonder Acute
needed most at the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe those simple moments really
were part of
the secret of her enduring
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Kashiwa Kinen. The fans
out there
may think I no longer have a
shot in a G1 race...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But they've got no way of knowing that
I've got
something inside me no one else
does.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, I'd say it's about time we got a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain has risen on a new race—a
new
chapter in this never-ending story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winds of change are always blowing.
The torch is continually passed from one
generation
of Umamusume to the next.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute stands firm against these
winds. She charges ever onward, carrying
the history of
dirt racing upon her
shoulders.
